_doc: The polysemy corpus: every measured collision between client vocabulary and federal procurement language, one entry per witnessed notice. This is an internal quality asset and the checkable record behind coverage claims. Guards derive their negative-context strings from here; nothing here encodes an engagement decision.
provenance_rule: Every entry a guard consumes carries the notice_id that produced it. An entry whose evidence lives only in session transcripts gets status 'unproven' and is NOT consumed by any guard until a real id is attached. A notice id is never invented; absence is recorded as absence. Enforced by tests/test_polysemy_corpus.py.
schema: term, collision_domain, resolution, notice_id, agency, naics, psc, date_observed, status; guard.consumers lists the code paths that read the entry (empty list: recorded observation, no guard consumes it yet); guard.phrase is the negative-context string a consumer loads.

entries.resolution: negative_context: a match near 'provider network' is discarded. 'provider network management' is insurance administration, not IT.
entries.note: Locally Employed Staff Health Insurance Services, U.S. Embassy Bishkek.

entries.collision_domain: social networking service boilerplate (TikTok prohibition FAR clause)
entries.resolution: negative_context: a match near 'social network' is discarded. The clause text names fiber optic, coaxial cable and Ethernet in the same sentence, so a domain anchor sits inside the boilerplate and the negative guard is the only thing standing.
entries.note: Ultracentrifuge equipment buy carrying the ByteDance/TikTok covered-application clause. Witness measured 2026-08-03; the phrase previously rode on 'generic' with no notice.

entries.resolution: negative_context: a match near 'neural network' is discarded.
entries.note: NAVSEA Naval Power and Energy Systems BAA N00024-19-R-4145: 'Recent trends in electrical machines include neural networks'. Same BAA also witnesses the observability entries. DOE spectroscopy licensing notice 70f1749ccd9641c388f088805ce5e98f is a second independent witness.

entries.note: NAVFACSYSCOM Pacific Sources Sought SEL2731, a brand-name market survey for the SEL-2731 substation Ethernet switch. Earlier ingest of the same notice: 7a4233f7e2ec43d7acf2c00927b6708f (codes blank).

entries.resolution: negative_context: a match near 'substation' is discarded.
entries.note: Same SEL2731 notice as the protection-and-automation entry.

entries.resolution: negative_context: a match near 'acoustic' is discarded. 'Reduce observability by ... reduction of acoustic and electromagnetic emissions' is stealth, not telemetry.
entries.note: NAVSEA Naval Power and Energy Systems BAA N00024-19-R-4145, latest posting 2026-06-12. Nine earlier postings of the same BAA carry the verbatim sentence; no other notice in the store uses 'reduce observability'.

entries.resolution: negative_context: a match near 'electromagnetic emissions' is discarded.
entries.note: Same NAVSEA BAA as the acoustic entry.

entries.resolution: entity guard: a single-token product name that is an ordinary English word must have the vendor named in the same notice (sam_lanes.reject_entity_hit, reason ambiguous_name_without_vendor). This notice is the false positive the guard class was built from.
entries.note: NOAA notice of intent to sole-source to InnovaSea: acoustic telemetry to quantify steelhead survival in Puget Sound. Sole 'steelhead' hit in the store.

entries.collision_domain: systems-engineering CM discipline on weapons programs
entries.resolution: recorded: 'configuration management' on a weapons program is the discipline of controlling design baselines, not the tooling category. No guard consumes per-term negative context today; the tier-2 tech-code gate is the only screen.
entries.note: Notice of Intent, follow-on to N6523618D1002 Air Defense Systems Integrator; matched the Red Hat CO frame.

entries.resolution: recorded: standalone 'APM' never means application performance monitoring in the store. Witness for the bare-acronym reject in term_routing (rule 5).
entries.note: NSWC Crane: SLING ASSEMBLY, APM VERTICAL LIFT.

entries.resolution: recorded: 'APM 1.8' is a part designation in a DLA rotary-pump RFQ.
entries.note: Approved sources include '62144 80012028/APM 1.8'.

entries.resolution: recorded: 'the APM, Tony Prudhomme' is a person, not a product category.
entries.note: Army Medical Training Command and Control continuation; submissions go to the APM, Tony Prudhomme.

entries.resolution: recorded: 'VALVE,FLOW CONTROL' item nomenclature collides with network flow vocabulary. Killed today by the NAICS boundary (332911 is not a tech prefix); the entry is the boundary's witness.
entries.note: DLA RFQ, Deliver To: DLA DISTRIBUTION RED RIVER. Sibling valve RFQs with identical delivery language: 0b87681aee084a6ab0ce75ce6da819d7, 37ef01a0da4b4288b885d96767cfd53a, 55ae44787f184daa8878c9bfcdff7da1.

entries.collision_domain: relays and solenoids hardware vs substation networking
entries.resolution: recorded: PSC 5945 covers both the SEL-2731 substation Ethernet switch and plain electrical solenoids; a code can never be a keyword. Witness for the codes-are-boundary-only doctrine.
entries.note: DLA RFQ for NSN 5945010792910 SOLENOID,ELECTRICAL, Deliver To: DLA DISTRIBUTION RED RIVER. Compare notice 97ad88c8e78340488386bc9b6f020333 (SEL2731) carrying PSC 5945 for a managed Ethernet switch.

entries.collision_domain: attribute of a buy, not the capability bought
entries.resolution: recorded: matched a fire-and-EMS records system because the RFP requires a FedRAMP High authorization package. True match, irrelevant buy. Witness for the attribute_not_capability qualify rule (list lives in screen_guards.json).
entries.note: FEMSRMS: Fire and Emergency Medical Services Records Management System.

entries.resolution: recorded: in federal healthcare procurement 'middleware' means laboratory instrument middleware connecting analyzers to a lab information system. Notably every nurse-call hit says middleware only to EXCLUDE it ('without the use of a third-party middleware'): a negated-term false positive. No guard consumes per-term negative context today.
entries.note: Nurse Call System Replacement RFI. The 2026-07-28 measurement recorded 3 nurse-call hits; the store holds 6 (also fe30cd4bf7a14b688e43973f9fafdde3, 5cf30427ba384a56b35b50dbc76b2953, ca2e81da4e9447ff8e1f1604335b236b, 070fd403ea584ec499d1e31781cda299, 375d188817a34817a5fee7c414b15b2d); the measured run's lookback window most plausibly caught one trio. Recorded as found, not forced to match the prose.

entries.resolution: recorded: BACT/Alert automated blood culture detection, one of the two measured blood-culture hits.
entries.note: Second measured blood-culture hit: e5994b8706824b64a866eadb20b278d8.

entries.resolution: recorded: antimicrobial susceptibility testing instrument that names its own middleware, MAESTRIA.
recorded: Signos continuous glucose monitoring matched via the PSC DH10 title boilerplate 'Database, Mainframe, Middleware', not a lab-middleware requirement. A code-description string, not the buy.
recorded: Data Innovations Instrument Manager, laboratory middleware by name, at Madigan Army Medical Center.
entries.note: The other two measured Instrument Manager hits: a25899de320b474d8ace75405f9da323, 4c0df3f7f5de4592b5e8cc29e7f5a9b0.

entries.resolution: recorded: three additional clinical middleware notices found 2026-08-03, beyond the measured set: Curian Analyzer (cites Data Innovation Instruments Manager middleware, also a false 'bact' substring on 'Heliobacter'), Core Lab Integration Atlanta VAMC ('unified middleware/analytics'), RTPCR GI/Respiratory Testing (VA Directive 6550 forms 'for each piece of equipment and middleware proposed').
entries.note: Companions: 56aa1cc42ce7439391e4f9e6e7df3211, bbe1ee3f4ef04db49c143e7760e7268f. Store-wide 'middleware' total 2026-08-03: 25 notices, 16 clinical; the non-clinical remainder includes Unmanned Common Controller x4, IRS tax software, NIST MES, MARAD UCAS.

entries.collision_domain: English idiom: area of responsibility ('under the purview of', possessive "DLA's purview")
entries.resolution: structural_routing: the bare token is never a screen term. Work order A1 (2026-08-17) routes the rival product through the vendor-qualified entity name 'Microsoft Purview' only; tools/frame_rescreen.py measures bare occurrences (42 notices, all idiom on sampling) and never keeps on them.
entries.note: ONR multi-functional devices sole-source: 'resolving any barriers to competition falls solely under DLA's purview'. A tech-coded record (334118/7F20), so a naive code-gated match would have passed; the structural routing is the guard.

entries.resolution: structural_routing: same as the ONR witness; bare token never screened.
entries.note: VA kitchen surveillance cameras: 'security equipment under the purview of the VA Police'.

entries.resolution: structural_routing: same as the ONR witness; bare token never screened.

common_word_products._doc: Single-token product names that are ordinary English words and therefore can never match without the vendor named in the same notice. This list is NOT per-notice observation data: it is a dictionary fallback, checkable against any English dictionary, used by sam_lanes.load_dictionary when no system dictionary exists and unioned with it when one does. The guard CLASS it feeds was built from the Innovasea steelhead notice recorded above.
